verdict.rationale: Databricks has a first-party documentation page dedicated to dbt that explains what dbt is, how to install dbt Core and how to connect it to Databricks, so dbt is a documented, vendor-supported integration. Missing for 10: the adapter package is not explicitly named, there is no evidence of native dbt project support inside the platform (e.g. running dbt in jobs or the workspace), there is no dbt Cloud coverage, and nothing independent or hands-on corroborates it.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, dbt is a first-class citizen — a documented adapter or native dbt project support with vendor docs to match

citations.quote: This page explains what dbt is, how to install dbt Core, and how to connect.
dbt Core enables you to write dbt code in the IDE of your choice on your local development machine and then run dbt from the command line.
dbt (data build tool) is a development environment for transforming data by writing select statements.
